title: add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add a set of RAG-focused agent quickstarts and examples plus accompanying docs site updates. Motivation: provide customers with opinionated, end-to-end examples showing how to wire up Redwood RAG templates, agent orchestration, and tool-calling (search, DB read/write, and external API calls) in both the hosted API and dedicated/private contexts. This PR includes three quickstarts (node/ts SDK, python SDK, and a minimal serverless example), three agent templates (faq-bot, ticket-assistant, data-annotator) that demonstrate KV cache usage and tool calling, docs pages (getting-started, agent-playbook, tool-calling guide), and example prompts/eval test vectors used by CI. Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart examples and README for each SDK - [x] Add agent templates with clear variable placeholders and sample tool adapters - [x] Add docs site pages and sidebars entries - [x] Update examples index and TOC - [x] Wire example CI evals to docs smoke tests - [x] Add minimal changelog/release notes Note: sized to be documentation and example additions only; no runtime or API surface changes. Related Linear tickets: ENG-3291 (agent templates), DOC-74 (docs site updates).
